raw_response: DESCRIPTION:The chart illustrates the negative log probability for different specialities, using a bar chart format. The horizontal axis represents the specialities, labeled as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, presented in that order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and spans a range from approximately -27 to -22, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The bars represent the negative log probability values for each speciality. Six different colors are used to represent the fine-tuned models: Cardio is represented by a light orange color, Gastro by a tan color, Infect by a light orange color, Neuro by a light orange color, Obstetrics by a light orange color, and Pediatrics by a light orange color. A single blue bar represents the Mistralv0.2-Base model. The bars for Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics are approximately of similar length, ranging from approximately -26.8 to -23.2. The Mistralv0.2-Base bar extends to approximately -27.2. The bars are not sorted in any particular order beyond the order of the speciality labels on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized.
